name: Robert Louis Stevenson SP
description: Robert Louis Stevenson State Park is a 5,272-acre undeveloped park north of Calistoga with trails to the summit of Mount St. Helena and views of Napa, Sonoma, and Lake counties. It is operated by the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District.
fullDescription: Robert Louis Stevenson State Park is a 5,272-acre undeveloped park north of Calistoga with trails to the summit of Mount St. Helena and views of Napa, Sonoma, and Lake counties. It is operated by the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking trails, including the climb to the summit of Mount St. Helena
- Vista points and geocaching
- No camping and no dogs allowed
- Open sunrise to sunset
howToGetIt:
No day use fee. Parking is a small lot on Highway 29, about 7 miles north of Calistoga, and fills early on busy days.

Call the park at (707) 942-4575 or see the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District website for trail conditions.
